ACT X OF 2011
ACT X OF 2011
EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Employment
of Children Act, 1991
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
2nd May, 2011
No.PAP-Legis-2(63)/2011/388, dated 2-5-2011.---The Employment of Children
(Amendment) Bill 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 30 March 2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 30
April 2011, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
Preamble.-Whereas it is expedient
further to amend the Employment of Children Act, 1991 (V of 1991), for purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.- (1) This Act may be cited as the Employment of
Children (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
